name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnisberg Rofan at Lake Achensee: Rofanseilbahn cable car to 1,840 m, spectacular AIRROFAN skyglider, Adlerhorst viewing platform, and a climbing paradise.
preis: Berg- und Talfahrt Erwachsene 30,50 €, Kinder 18,50 €; Flug ab 18,00 €
oeffnungszeiten: Ende April bis Anfang Nov täglich 08:30–17:00 Uhr (Hochsommer ab 08:00 Uhr)
beschreibung:
Overview

The Erlebnisberg Rofan (listed in the database as Erlebnisberg Achensee) rises directly above Maurach on the eastern shore of Lake Achensee. Accessible via the long-established Rofanseilbahn cable car, the lift whisks outdoor enthusiasts from 980 metres above sea level up to the sunny mountain plateau at 1,840 metres in just a few minutes. Framed by the limestone crags of the Rofangebirge and offering sweeping vistas down onto the „Tiroler Meer“, the mountain provides a harmonious combination of scenic pasture hikes, challenging via ferratas, and innovative flight attractions.

History & Attractions

The history of alpine tourism here began on 1 July 1959 with the ceremonial opening of the bi-cable aerial tramway, which has since carried generations of holidaymakers into the high mountains; in 2016, the entire ropeway technology underwent complete modernization. The absolute highlight of the Erlebnisberg is the AIRROFAN Skyglider, installed in 2007: designed in the shape of a majestic eagle, this thrilling glider pulls up to four passengers secured prone backwards over 200 vertical metres up towards the Gschöllkopf, before being released to soar downhill at an exhilarating speed exceeding 80 km/h. At the 2,039-metre summit of the Gschöllkopf perches the Aussichtsplattform „Adlerhorst“ – a 15-tonne circular iron construction crafted by Tyrolean blacksmith Manfred Hörl, modeled after a giant eagle's nest, offering a breathtaking 360-degree panorama over Achensee, Karwendel, the Zillertaler Alpen, and the Inntal valley. Climbers also prize the famous 5-Gipfel-Klettersteig, which links five prominent peaks of the Rofan range.

Visit & Getting There

The Rofanseilbahn operates during the summer season from late April to early November, daily from 08:30 to 17:00 (during midsummer from 08:00 to 17:30). In winter, the ski season runs from mid-December to late March. Weather permitting, the AIRROFAN Skyglider operates daily from 09:00 to 16:15. Cable car tickets for summer 2025/2026: ascent and descent for adults €30.50, children (born 2011–2019) €18.50, children under 6 ride free. Single flight on AIRROFAN: adults €18.00, children €12.50 (requirements: at least 10 years old and 1.30 m in height). Access to the Aussichtsplattform Adlerhorst is free of charge. By public transport: ÖBB train to Jenbach station, then bus line 4080 every half hour directly to the Maurach Rofanseilbahn stop in front of the valley station. By car: Inntalautobahn A12, exit Wiesing/Achensee, follow B181 to Maurach (Achenseestraße 10, ample parking at the valley station).

Tips

The valley and top stations of the cable car as well as the mountain restaurant at the summit station (Erfurter Hütte) provide step-free, wheelchair-accessible facilities; large cabins easily accommodate wheelchairs and strollers. (Note: the alpine hiking trail leading from the mountain station up to the Adlerhorst climbs roughly 200 vertical metres over rocky steps and is not barrier-free). Visit the Adlerhorst on clear mornings to enjoy the most spectacular distant visibility.
